verdict.rationale: Azure documents a first-party declarative template surface: ARM templates are explicitly positioned for infrastructure as code, and Bicep is a declarative DSL for deploying Azure resources. Terraform guidance is also provided, but Terraform is a third-party tool. Nothing in the pack shows a typed, general-purpose-language CDK-style framework, and nothing documents deployment state tracking or rollback behavior. missing for 10: typed CDK-style framework, documented state/rollback semantics, independent hands-on corroboration of the IaC workflow.
